The strongest signal points to **currencyservice causing latency**. Starting at 22:06, frontend and checkoutservice p90 both rise, while currencyservice p90 also increases and its CPU rises as its request rate falls. Currencyservice is a dependency of both affected services. Its CPU is not obviously saturated, so the telemetry supports a **delay** fault more than a CPU-capacity fault.

Adservice has a notable disk-I/O spike around the same time, but its latency metric stays at zero; the available telemetry does not connect that spike to the user-facing slowdown. No error-log counts or error-rate data are provided, so this points to a likely cause rather than proving one.
